issue_context.title: Add missing events as telemetry
issue_context.body:
Following: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/186/files

This issue is about adding the missing telemetry information to Meilisearch

[Reminder](https://docs.meilisearch.com/learn/what_is_meilisearch/telemetry.html#what-tools-do-we-use-to-collect-and-visualize-data):

> We collect telemetry data for only two reasons: so that we can improve our product, and so that we can continue working on this project full-time.
>
> In order to create a better product, we need reliable quantitative information. The data we collect helps us fix bugs, evaluate the success of features, and better understand our users' needs.
>
> We also need to prove that people are actually using Meilisearch. Usage metrics help us justify our existence to investors so that we can keep this project alive.
[#](https://docs.meilisearch.com/learn/what_is_meilisearch/telemetry.html#why-should-you-trust-us)

## Impacted teams

@meilisearch/docs-team
comments: Is this issue finished @irevoire? Can we close it thanks to #3059 #3060 #3063 #3065?

Thanks for noticing!

Oh, I didn’t know that 😲 
Sorry lord GitHub, once again, I doubted you; I hope you will pardon me :eye: :lips: :eye:
